requirements.statement: incident bundle export and import postconditions remain exact across every retained executable selector and declared fixture/runtime boundary.
Incident Bundles applies the complete extension portability state and claim matrix, distinct export/import-preparation results, bounded scoped staging, and one final publication transaction.

Incident Bundles exports current Timeline source state only through the logical Bundle v2 owner codec, imports Bundle v1 only through a bounded time-limited compatibility decoder, and never treats Timeline physical table rows as the current portability contract.
